origin: Independently written bounded adaptation of Yogar EX1 fib_safe-6.i. Four additions per worker instead of six, local loop indices, joins before observation, and the equivalent constant F(10). P0 injects a one-unit bias into the left update.
thread_bound: Exactly two workers, one creation per worker; four iterations per worker.
property: After both joins neither component exceeds Fibonacci number F(10) = 55.
assumptions: Both components start at one; each addition is atomic; fixed size unsigned arithmetic has no overflow for these values.
intent: Remove the additive bias while preserving the atomic update and both four-iteration workers.
